name: Mukunoki Mimi
source:
"Because they are always infinite, the potentials of a maiden."

The president of the Maiden Club and a third-year student in the Knight Training Department. She has excellent communication skills and can get along with anyone. Also a talented knight, she is the perfect rival for [url=/c124653]Iyo[/url]. She likes to play pranks, especially on her beloved younger sister [url=/c124655]Lili[/url], often teasing her and then patting her afterwards.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/29.otohime/character_mimi.html]official website[/url]]
